acceptanceCriteria: Cargo metadata and lockfile identify v0.2.72, and the current release/versioning guidance in English, Simplified Chinese, and Japanese names v0.2.72 while retaining v0.2.71 as the immediately preceding public baseline.
Release CI produces the five-target public archive and SBOM set with a manifest, SHA256SUMS, provenance, attestation, and runtime identity bound to the reviewed tag.
Post-release acceptance uses only downloaded public v0.2.72 artifacts in isolated roots, proves forbidden-root isolation and run-root cleanup, and validates the same binary against this repository.

The release starts from the synchronized ready default branch, preserves failed-tag history, and changes no Runtime behavior, object repository, global Agent/MCP configuration, or unrelated historical records.
goal: Create the next auditable Runtime release, update current version guidance, and prove the downloaded v0.2.72 binary can govern this repository without source fallback.
intent: Publish v0.2.72 from the reviewed default branch and validate its immutable public artifacts and adopter installation boundary.
outOfScope: Reference-source code or Python/Shell implementation copying
Rewriting failed tags or historical Work Item/evidence bytes
